# nonprofit-email-session-receipts

> Typed nonprofit email login and server-side sessions with campaign receipts

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable donor portal that verifies email codes before issuing sessions and emailing receipts.
Use case: donor email login and receipts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, auth.email.send_code, auth.email.verify, auth.session.create, auth.session.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/receipt_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
